# A friendly place for app makers

I’d like everyone to feel comfortable asking questions and sharing ideas here.

- Be kind and specific. It’s fine to disagree with an idea; please don’t attack the person.
- Respect other people’s privacy and work.
- Keep things relevant. No harassment, spam, or repeated unwanted messages.

If something feels wrong, [contact me privately](mailto:asterustudio@inbox.ru). I may remove content or limit participation to keep the conversation welcoming.
